agent_declaration.tradeoff_reason: P081 has the higher incremental_rank_correlation (0.2207 vs 0.1942) and higher final-affinity rank correlation (0.5331 vs -0.0480), but it is much larger (20 slots vs 4) and leaves only 5 free slots, whereas P009 leaves 21 free slots and has a higher nearest-rest pic50 mean (8.0029 vs 7.9756). Choosing P081 favors a broad supported context; choosing P009 favors a smaller, more permissive constraint. Both are retained because their union is evaluated as one reward, and their individual effects have not been compared.
